task: Issue #727: exclude Trivy ConfigAuditReports of scaled-down (spec.replicas == 0) ReplicaSets and verify Deployment ownership in Portal Compliance.

events.summary: Explicit owner decision (2026-11-19): grant ClusterRole narwhal-portal read-only get/list on apps/replicasets and filter scaled-down ReplicaSets in the portal. No watch, write verbs, or wildcard rules; no new dependencies; no live cluster mutation or push.

After Deployment rollouts, trivy-operator retains ConfigAuditReports for old spec.replicas == 0 ReplicaSets (e.g. velero, trivy-operator, keycloak-operator). portal/src/lib/compliance.ts previously listed only configauditreports without inspecting ReplicaSets, counting stale revisions as live findings; compliance-accepted.ts also collapsed any SafeEncodeString hash suffix without checking metadata.ownerReferences.

Added get/list on apps/replicasets to ClusterRole narwhal-portal (narwhal-portal-k8s.yaml). Added cached cluster-wide /apis/apps/v1/replicasets lookup (compliance:replicasets:list, 60s TTL) in portal/src/lib/compliance.ts: drops ReplicaSet reports with spec.replicas === 0 from list/detail/summary, fails safe (keeps reports and logs one warning without caching failure) on fetch error or missing ReplicaSet, and passes metadata.ownerReferences Deployment names to normalizeWorkloadName/matchConfigAuditException in compliance-accepted.ts so hash suffixes collapse only with a matching Deployment owner (keeping the SafeEncodeString fallback when ownership is unknown without broadening acceptance). Updated docs/common/compliance-hardening.md, lessons-log.md, changelogs, and R375.
